conflicts.description: Multiple target files already have uncommitted changes. Blind edits can overwrite active work.
conflicts.strategy: Before implementation, inspect file-level diffs and integrate snapshot changes as small targeted patches.
conflicts.impact: Implementation order must start with database/service files that have no existing edits, then carefully adapt existing payroll services.

conflicts.strategy: Add snapshot controls in a compact toolbar area after reading current component structure. Avoid large UI rewrites.
conflicts.impact: UI task should be executed after backend API contract is stable.

conflicts.description: Automation, export, beras automation, and AD reset currently fetch live payroll data independently.
conflicts.strategy: Introduce a single payroll source options object and pass it through all downstream calls.
conflicts.impact: Tests must prove snapshot source does not call live gateway functions.

summary: Proceed with a sequential implementation plan. Start with additive snapshot service/schema, then source selection, then routes, downstream integrations, UI, and tests.
